AMC 10A 2023 — Problem 15

Nested Circles

An even number of circles are nested, starting with a radius of 1 and increasing by 1 each time, all sharing a common point at the bottom.

The region between every other circle is shaded, starting with the region inside the circle of radius 2 but outside the circle of radius 1.

What is the least number of circles needed to make the total shaded area at least 2023π?

Area of each shaded ring
Area = π(4×1 − 1) = 3π
